entries.source: units/34-differential-forms/problems.html P1, worked solution part 4: 'For alpha, naturality gives gamma^*alpha = d(gamma^*(xyz)) = d(t sin t cos t), so int_gamma alpha = [t sin t cos t]_0^{2pi} = 0' (pullback of yz dx + xz dy + xy dz on x = cos t, y = sin t, z = t)

units/36-schwarzschild/problems.html P6, rung 2: 'do not integrate dtau = dr/|rdot| head-on: substitute r = r_0/2(1 + cos eta)'; worked solution part 2: 'Put r = r_0/2(1 + cos eta) = r_0 cos^2(eta/2) ... |rdot| = c sqrt(r_s/r_0)|tan(eta/2)|' (with rdot^2 = c^2 r_s(1/r - 1/r_0))
units/36-schwarzschild/problems.html P6, worked solution part 2: 'dtau = r_0/(2c) sqrt(r_0/r_s)(1 + cos eta) deta, which integrates from eta = 0 (at r = r_0) to the stated tau(eta)'
units/36-schwarzschild/problems.html P6, worked solution part 3: 'dt/dr ~ -r_s/c 1/(r - r_s),  t ~ -r_s/c ln(r/r_s - 1) + const'

units/36-schwarzschild/problems.html P7, rung 2: 'Differentiate the given F rather than integrating from scratch'; worked solution part 1: 'r_s int (1 - 1/x)^{-1/2} dx. Differentiating the proposed antiderivative, F'(x) = ... = sqrt(x/(x-1))'
units/36-schwarzschild/problems.html P7, rung 2: 'expand (1 - 1/x)^{-1/2} ~ 1 + 1/(2x) and integrate term by term'; worked solution part 3: 'l ~ (r_2 - r_1) + r_s/2 ln(r_2/r_1)'

units/36-schwarzschild/problems.html P13, rung 2: 'For the integral, substitute r = r_s sin^2 psi'; worked solution part 2: 'dr = 2r_s sin psi cos psi dpsi and sqrt(r_s/r - 1) = cos psi/sin psi, so the integrand becomes 2r_s sin^2 psi dpsi'

units/37-classical-tests/problems.html P6, rung 2: 'Expand w_0^2 into constant, cos phi and cos 2phi parts'; rung 3 / worked solution: 'w_0^2 = 1 + 1/2 e^2 + 2e cos phi + 1/2 e^2 cos 2phi' ... 'int_0^{2pi} w_0^2 cos phi dphi = 2e pi' (w_0 = 1 + e cos phi; e renamed e1)

units/39-cosmology/problems.html P8, worked solution part 1: 'a = A(1 - cos theta), theta = beta eta ... and t = int_0^eta a deta' = A/beta (theta - sin theta)'
